component.$description: Layer 3 - Component: tokens scoped to a specific UI component, composed exclusively from semantic tokens. Atoms: button, icon-button, input, checkbox, radio, switch, badge, avatar, tooltip, link, divider, progress, skeleton. Layout: app-shell, sidebar, topbar, page, card, stat-card, table, tabs, segmented-control, dropdown, modal, alert, chart.

button.$description: Atom - Button. Consumes only semantic tokens.

size.$description: Padding, min-height, font and icon size per button size.

color.$description: Color per variant and state. Filled variants: primary, secondary, tertiary, accent, success, info, danger (ember/coral, rose/sky, purple/rose, gold, green, blue, red). Outline, ghost and link are neutral. Text on each fill is text.on-<variant>.

shadow.$description: Elevation of the filled variants (primary, secondary, danger): raised at rest, lifted on hover, flat when pressed or disabled. Outline and ghost stay flat.

icon-button.$description: Atom - Icon-only button (toolbar, table row actions, topbar). Square; reuses button.color variants.

input.$description: Atom - Text input / select / textarea / search field.

checkbox.$description: Atom - Checkbox. Checked fill uses brand.primary-strong (>= 3:1 on white) with a text.on-primary check mark.

radio.$description: Atom - Radio. Same palette as checkbox; indicator is the inner dot.

size.$description: Switch.IconOn / Switch.IconOff, drawn inside the thumb.

tone.$description: Color variants of the on state (primary is the default, in track.on).

badge.$description: Atom - Badge / status pill / tag (table status, counts, filters).

size.$description: Height, inline padding and type per badge/tag size.

spinner.$description: Atom - Spinner. Arc color per variant; the track is shared.

avatar.$description: Atom - Avatar (user menu, table owner column).

tooltip.$description: Atom - Tooltip (chart hovers, truncated labels, icon buttons).

offset.$description: Distance between the trigger and the tooltip.

kbd.$description: Atom - Keyboard key (shortcuts in menus, tooltips, help text).

border-width-bottom.$description: Thicker bottom edge that makes the key read as a key.

divider.$description: Atom - Divider. Line thickness and color per emphasis.

control-height.$description: Height of the pointer target around the track.

tone.$description: Color variants of the fill and thumb border (primary is the default, in fill / thumb-border).

skeleton.$description: Atom - Loading skeleton for cards, charts and table rows.

app-shell.$description: Layout - App shell: sidebar + topbar + scrollable content region.

sidebar.$description: Layout - Sidebar navigation (light). Active item = primary tint + primary indicator bar.

topbar.$description: Layout - Top app bar (page title, search, notifications, user menu).

page.$description: Layout - Page / content region inside the shell.

card.$description: Layout - Card: container for charts, lists and widgets.

header-gap.$description: Space between the title and subtitle.

tone.$description: Background variants. Each sets the fill, the border and the border shown while an interactive card is hovered. default uses color.background / border / border-hover.

stat-card.$description: Layout - KPI / stat card: label, big value, trend delta, optional icon tile.

tabs.$description: Layout - Tabs (switch dashboard views / time ranges).

accordion.$description: Molecule - Accordion (FAQs, settings sections, filter panels).

radius.$description: Corner radius of the filled variants.

filled-padding-inline.$description: Trigger and panel inline padding of the filled variants, so text clears the fill edge.

background.$description: Fill of the whole accordion. default is transparent; the others draw a filled, bordered, rounded block.

icon-filled.$description: Chevron on the filled variants; icon.secondary drops under 3:1 on the brand tint.

tone.$description: Text color variants (AA on the page surfaces). Neutral is the default, in link / current.

dropdown.$description: Layout - Dropdown menu / popover (filters, user menu).

offset.$description: Distance between the trigger and the menu.

popover.$description: Molecule - Popover: non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger.

offset.$description: Distance between the trigger and the popup.

select.$description: Molecule - Select popup and options. The trigger uses the input tokens.

offset.$description: Distance between the trigger and the popup when placed below or above it.

combobox.$description: Molecule - Combobox and Autocomplete popup and options. The input uses the input tokens.

offset.$description: Distance between the input and the popup.
Distance from the viewport edges; also how far a toast slides in.

gap.$description: Space between the icon, content and actions.

content-gap.$description: Space between the title and description.

accent-width.$description: Leading-edge stripe that marks the tone.

viewport-inset.$description: Minimum space kept between the dialog and the viewport edges.

enter-scale.$description: Scale the dialog grows from while it fades in.

content-gap.$description: Space between the title and description.

padding-inline.$description: Matches page content so banner text lines up with it.

chart.$description: Layout - Chart container inside a card.
